pred_sql: SELECT s.CharterNum, ss.AvgScrWrite FROM schools s JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds WHERE ss.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ss.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.CharterNum, s.School, AVG(ss.AvgScrWrite) as avg_writing_score FROM schools s INNER JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds WHERE ss.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.CDSCode ORDER BY avg_writing_score DESC;

SELECT s.charter_number, AVG(sc.score) as avg_score FROM schools s JOIN scores sc ON s.id = sc.school_id WHERE sc.score_type='Writing' AND sc.score > 499 AND s.charter_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.id, s.charter_number ORDER BY avg_score DESC;

SELECT s.CharterNum, AVG(ss.AvgScrWrite) as avg_writing_score FROM schools s INNER JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds WHERE ss.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.CharterNum ORDER BY avg_writing_score DESC;
